an6.29:1.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ āmantesi
an6.29:1.3: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyi tuṇhī ahosi.
an6.29:1.4: dutiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ āmantesi
an6.29:1.6: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyi tuṇhī ahosi.
an6.29:1.7: tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ āmantesi
an6.29:1.9: tatiyampi kho āyasmā udāyi tuṇhī ahosi.
an6.29:2.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca
an6.29:2.4: idha bhante bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati seyyathīdaṃ ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati
an6.29:3.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
an6.29:4.3: idha bhante bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an6.29:4.4: idaṃ bhante anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārāya saṃvattati.
an6.29:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhante bhikkhu ālokasaññaṃ manasikaroti divā saññaṃ adhiṭṭhāti yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā
an6.29:5.2: iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sampabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti
an6.29:5.3: idaṃ bhante anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ ñāṇadassanapaṭilābhāya saṃvattati.
an6.29:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhante bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adhokesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūrannānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati
an6.29:6.2: atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nahārū aṭṭhī aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā khelo siṃghāṇikā lasikā muttanti
an6.29:6.3: idaṃ bhante anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ kāmarāgassa pahānāya saṃvattati.
an6.29:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhante bhikkhu seyyathāpi passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ ekāhamataṃ vā dvīhamataṃ vā tīhamataṃ vā uddhumātakaṃ vinīlakaṃ vipubbakajātaṃ
an6.29:7.3: ayampi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃ anatītoti
an6.29:8.1: seyyathā vā pana passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ kākehi vā khajjamānaṃ kulalehi vā khajjamānaṃ gijjhehi vā khajjamānaṃ suvāṇehi vā khajjamānaṃ siṃgālehi vā khajjamānaṃ vividhehi vā pāṇakajātehi khajjamānaṃ
an6.29:8.3: ayampi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃ anatītoti
an6.29:9.1: seyyathā vā pana passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikasaṃkhalikaṃ samaṃsalohitaṃ nahārusambandhaṃ aṭṭhikasaṃkhalikaṃ
an6.29:9.4: aṭṭhikāni apagatasambandhāni disā vidisā vikkhittāni aññena hatthaṭṭhikaṃ aññena pādaṭṭhikaṃ aññena jaṅghaṭṭhikaṃ aññena ūruṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṭiṭṭhikaṃ aññena piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṭṭhikaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ so imameva kāyaṃ evaṃ upasaṃharati ayampi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃ anatītoti seyyathā vā pana passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni setāni saṃkhavaṇṇūpanibhāni aṭṭhikāni puñjakitāni terovassikāni pūtīni cuṇṇakajātāni
an6.29:9.6: ayampi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃ anatītoti
an6.29:9.7: idaṃ bhante anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ asmimānasamugghātāya saṃvattati.
an6.29:10.1: puna caparaṃ bhante bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an6.29:10.2: idaṃ bhante anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ anekadhātupaṭivedhāya saṃvattati
an6.29:11.2: tenahi tvaṃ ānanda idampi chaṭṭhaṃ anussatiṭṭhānaṃ dhārehi
an6.29:11.3: idhānanda bhikkhu satova abhikkamati satova paṭikkamati satova tiṭṭhati satova nisīdati satova seyyaṃ kappeti satova kammaṃ adhiṭṭhāti
an6.29:11.4: idaṃ ānanda anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ satisampajaññāya saṃvattatīti. 30
